subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of the Angami Sekrenyi festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cleanse body and soul**__.

**__Key Points__**

__

• The **Sekrenyi** festival is the premier annual event of the **Angami Naga** tribe of **Nagaland**, which serves as a major cultural landmark for the community.

• The primary objective of the festival is **Phousanyi**, a term that signifies **purification**. It is observed to **cleanse the body and soul** of all past transgressions and misfortunes, seeking spiritual renewal.

• The celebration lasts for **ten days** and begins on the 25th day of the month of **Kezei** (which usually falls in February), marking the start of the **Angami lunar year**.

• A central theme of the festival is to bring **unity** and **sanctification** to the community, ensuring that the villagers enter the new agricultural cycle with a pure spirit and a healthy body.

 **Additional Information__**

• **Angami Naga Community**:

• The Angamis are one of the 17 major recognized tribes of **Nagaland**, primarily settled in the **Kohima** and **Chumoukedima** districts.

• They are famously known for their mastery in **terrace cultivation** and the preservation of rich oral traditions and folk music.

• **Ritualistic Highlights**:

• **Kizie Ritual**: This involves the symbolic sprinkling of **rice water** (Zhumho) from a leaf, intended to ward off **unlucky spirits** and illness.

• **Themlhu Day**: On the most sacred day, the village men perform a **ritual bath** at the village well before dawn. The water is treated as **holy**, and this act is believed to wash away all spiritual impurities.

• The festival features vibrant **traditional attire**, the preparation of local pork delicacies, and the communal sharing of **rice beer**, fostering social bonds.

• **Regional Significance**:

• While Sekrenyi is tribal-specific, Nagaland also hosts the famous **Hornbill Festival** in December, which showcases the collective heritage of all Naga tribes at the **Kisama Heritage Village**.
